espira.title: Espira
espira.description: Relaxing massage focused on the upper body — neck, shoulders, cervical area and back. It closes with craniofacial work to settle the nervous system and bring back calm, lightness and presence.
espira.body:
Espira is a relaxation ritual for the upper body — neck, cervical area, shoulders and back, where the tension of the day tends to settle.

Through enveloping movements, gentle pressure and an unhurried rhythm, the treatment helps the muscles let go, softens the tension and builds a state of deep calm.

It closes with a craniofacial massage, designed to carry the nervous system towards deeper relaxation, rest and presence.

0.title: Upper-body relaxation
0.description: Works the neck, shoulders and back with a gentle, enveloping and deeply relaxing approach.

1.title: An unhurried rhythm
1.description: An experience made to step out of the pace of the day and carry the body towards calm.

2.title: A sensory close
2.description: The craniofacial massage completes the experience, taking the body into deeper relaxation and a full sense of calm.

pulse.title: Pulse
pulse.description: Deep tissue therapeutic massage, made to ease knots, reduce muscular stiffness and give the body back its mobility when rest alone no longer shifts the tension.
pulse.body:
Pulse is a deep tissue therapeutic massage for the upper body, built to work on areas of built-up tension, stiffness and muscular overload, above all in the back, neck and shoulders.

Through firm pressure, specific manoeuvres and precise work on the muscle, the treatment helps release knots, improve mobility and ease that feeling of being blocked.

It suits people with recurring muscular discomfort, physical stress, sedentary work or accumulated tension who need something deeper and more targeted.

0.title: Deep, precise work
0.description: Works the muscles of the upper body to ease built-up tension and overloaded areas.

1.title: Releases knots and stiffness
1.description: Helps reduce that blocked feeling in the neck, shoulders and back.

2.title: Mobility and relief
2.description: A treatment aimed at recovering freedom of movement, release and muscular wellbeing.

drenaje-linfatico.title: Advanced Lymphatic Drainage
drenaje-linfatico.description: An advanced protocol combining manual lymphatic drainage, a personalised assessment and integrated therapeutic photobiomodulation, to follow processes of inflammation, fluid retention, recovery and balance in the body.
drenaje-linfatico.body:
Advanced Lymphatic Drainage · Método Essentia comes out of years of study, practice and evolution across different manual lymphatic drainage techniques. It starts from the classic principles of drainage and adapts them to a more current, deeper and more personal view of the body.

Through rhythmic, precise and enveloping movements, the method works with the natural functioning of the lymphatic system, following processes of inflammation, fluid retention, heaviness, recovery and balance in the body.

As part of that evolution, the treatment closes with a phase of therapeutic photobiomodulation using red and infrared light, applied over the area worked to support the tissue, encourage the feeling of recovery and deepen the experience.

At Essentia we believe aesthetics begin with health. This treatment goes past appearance: it looks after the body from a therapeutic standpoint, reading the tissue, the inflammation, the breathing and how the body responds, so each session fits what that person actually needs.

0.title: Inflammation and retention
0.description: We work with the lymphatic system to move fluid, ease heaviness and reduce that swollen feeling.

1.title: Therapeutic photobiomodulation
1.description: The closing phase with red and infrared light is applied over the area worked, to support recovery, tissue and wellbeing.

2.title: A personalised method
2.description: We read the tissue, the breathing and how the body responds, so each session fits what it actually needs.

essentia-active.title: Essentia Active
essentia-active.description: Muscle recovery massage made to ease tired legs, reduce physical overload and give the body back lightness, rest and vitality.
essentia-active.body:
Essentia Active is a massage for the legs and nothing else, made to ease heaviness, fatigue and muscular overload.

Through release work, pressure adapted to you and stimulating movement, the treatment helps let go of built-up tension, encourage mobility and bring lightness back to the legs.

It suits active people, athletes, or anyone who spends long hours on their feet and needs to recover rest, freshness and wellbeing in the legs.

0.description: Helps ease overload, fatigue and that heavy-legged feeling after training, physical work or long hours on the go.

1.title: Lightness in the legs
1.description: Works the tension built up in tired legs and muscles to bring back rest, mobility and wellbeing.

2.title: An active body, looked after
2.description: A treatment made to support physical performance, keep overload in check and hold the body in better shape.

nurtura.title: Nurtura
nurtura.description: A gentle, enveloping prenatal massage, designed to ease tension, reduce swelling and support the body through pregnancy with calm, safety and care.
nurtura.body:
Nurtura is a prenatal massage created to support a woman through pregnancy with a delicate, safe and deeply careful approach.

Through gentle techniques, an unhurried rhythm and pressure adapted to her, the treatment helps ease muscular tension, heaviness and the swelling that comes with this stage, making room for more rest and wellbeing.

Each session adapts to where the pregnancy is, to the state of the body and to what the mother needs, creating a space of calm, connection and care for her and for the baby.

0.title: Relief through pregnancy
0.description: Helps reduce tension in the back, the legs and the areas carrying the load, following the body's natural changes at this stage.

1.title: Less heaviness and swelling
1.description: Gentle, adapted techniques to encourage lightness, rest and greater physical comfort.

2.title: Safe, conscious care
2.description: We respect every stage of pregnancy with delicate, adapted support. Suitable from the second trimester onwards, provided there is no medical contraindication.

serenna.title: Serenna
serenna.description: Full-body relaxing massage made to slow the pace down, release built-up tension and bring the body back to a deep sense of calm and rest.
serenna.body:
Serenna is an experience of deep calm, created to pause the body's pace and carry it into real rest.

Through gentle, continuous and harmonious movements, the treatment invites you to let go, breathe and reconnect with a sense of inner serenity.

The pressure adapts to each person, bringing together conscious touch and an enveloping rhythm to create an experience of rest, presence and wellbeing.

2.title: Reconnecting with the body

solea.title: Soléa
solea.description: Post-sun ritual with an aloe vera wrap and full-body massage, designed to calm, hydrate and bring comfort back to the skin after sun exposure.
solea.body:
Soléa is a post-sun ritual created to look after the skin and the body after sun exposure, above all when there is heat, sensitivity, dryness or redness.

The session brings together an aloe vera wrap and a relaxing full-body massage, helping to cool, hydrate and calm the skin while the body settles into deep rest.

It suits anyone looking to recover comfort, softness and balance after days of sun, beach or pool.

Through deep, precise manoeuvres, it helps release tension, improve mobility and bring the body back to a sense of wellbeing.

lume.description: A multisensory experience of deep wellbeing, bringing together body massage, craniofacial work, reflexology and aromatherapy to quiet the mind and restore balance.
lume.body:
Lume is a multisensory experience of deep wellbeing, created for anyone after a real disconnection and complete rest for body and mind.

Through a combination of relaxing massage, craniofacial work, foot reflexology and manual techniques, the ritual helps release tension, calm the nervous system and recover a deep sense of wellbeing.

More than a massage, Lume is a pause to reconnect with yourself, restore balance and feel the body from a place of calm again.

alure-duo.title: Alure Duo
alure-duo.description: A sensory ritual for two, designed to share calm, presence and care in an experience made for reconnecting through touch and wellbeing.

Alure Duo is a wellbeing experience designed for two people who want to give themselves a moment of calm, connection and shared care.

More than a couples massage, it is a sensory ritual where every detail is there to create an intimate, elegant and memorable pause. Through touch, breathing and a carefully prepared setting, the body lets go and the moment becomes something to remember.

It suits couples, special occasions, or anyone who wants to share a space of wellbeing built on presence, quiet and mutual care.

essentia-signature.title: Essentia Signature
essentia-signature.description: Our most complete ritual: a premium body and facial renewal experience combining exfoliation, a hydrating wrap, a rejuvenating facial and a full-body massage.
essentia-signature.body:
Essentia is our most exclusive ritual, designed to revitalise the skin, restore balance in the body and turn self-care into a complete sensory experience.

It opens with a natural-fibre body peeling to renew the skin and prepare it to take in the actives. An ultra-hydrating, toning wrap then brings nourishment, softness and comfort to the body.

The experience continues with a rejuvenating facial and craniofacial massage, using high-end products such as Aurum Cream, formulated with micro-active gold and aloe vera to bring radiance, hydration and an immediate sense of freshness and renewal.

To close, a relaxing full-body massage helps release tension, deepen the feeling of rest and finish the ritual in a state of profound wellbeing.

As a final touch, we include an exclusive wash bag with selected products from the treatment, so the Essentia experience stays with you beyond the session.

aurum.title: Aurum
aurum.description: Regenerating facial ritual with gold leaf, premium Aurum cosmetics and Kobido-inspired technique, to nourish, revitalise and bring natural radiance back to the face.

Aurum is a facial ritual designed to bring radiance, nourishment and vitality back to the skin through a deeply sensory experience.

It combines exfoliation, gold leaf, premium Aurum cosmetics by Utsukusy and manual work inspired by Kobido massage, to stimulate the tissue, soften the visible signs of tiredness and reveal a fresher, more rested and luminous face.

It suits dull or devitalised skin, or skin that needs to recover light, softness and a sense of natural renewal.

It combines facial wood therapy, natural hyaluronic acid and specific manual work to stimulate the tissue, improve the feeling of firmness and support the skin's own collagen production.

Kinéa Signature is an advanced facial method designed to work the face from a deeper, more natural and more personal standpoint.

It does not stop at the skin: it works the structures behind expression and facial ageing — posture, breathing, fascia, muscle and the tension held there.

Through precise manual technique, the treatment sets out to release, reorganise and guide the face towards a more defined, rested and harmonious look, always keeping it natural.

essentia-iv-signature.title: Essentia IV Signature
essentia-iv-signature.description: Advanced Lymphatic Drainage · Essentia Method combined with a formula developed with VitalDrip: NAD+, magnesium, vitamin C and L-carnitine.

The manual work comes first, moving fluid and supporting the lymphatic system. The intravenous formula follows — NAD+, magnesium, vitamin C and L-carnitine — sustaining from within what the drainage set in motion.

It is the longest session in the catalogue and the most complete. Like the rest, it is decided after assessment: if it is not the right moment, we will suggest another.

contrast-therapy.title: Contrast Therapy
contrast-therapy.heroAlt: Contrast therapy — sauna and cold plunge at Essentia
contrast-therapy.intro: Alternating heat and cold is one of the most studied recovery modalities in sports science. At Essentia, we have designed a structured protocol that maximises the cardiovascular, hormonal, and anti-inflammatory response of each transition.
contrast-therapy.benefitsSubtitle: The science behind thermal contrast is well established. These are the mechanisms that matter most.

0.title: Reduces inflammation
0.description: Cold immersion constricts blood vessels and clears metabolic waste. Repeated transitions accelerate the clearance of inflammatory markers after training or injury.

1.title: Stimulates heat shock proteins
1.description: Sustained sauna exposure triggers HSP production — molecular chaperones that repair damaged proteins and protect cells against future stress.

2.title: Improves cardiovascular resilience
2.description: The rapid vasoconstriction and vasodilation cycle trains the autonomic nervous system and improves heart rate variability over time.

3.title: Enhances sleep quality
3.description: The drop in core temperature after cold exposure signals the brain to enter deeper sleep phases, shortening sleep onset and increasing slow-wave duration.

contrast-therapy.sessionSubtitle: Sessions are guided. You will never be left to figure it out alone.

I.title: Duration
I.description: 60 minutes. Three alternating rounds: 12–15 minutes in the sauna followed by 2–3 minutes in the cold plunge. Short rest between rounds.

II.title: Format
II.description: Solo or shared. Our therapist sets the protocol based on your goal: recovery, activation, or adaptation. First session includes a brief assessment.

III.title: Frequency
III.description: Two to three sessions per week is optimal for most members. We track your response and adjust the protocol as your baseline improves.

contrast-therapy.ctaBody: Contrast Therapy is included in all Essentia memberships. Book your first session or join the community to get started.

breathing-sessions.title: Breathing Sessions
breathing-sessions.intro: Controlled respiration is the fastest lever we have over the autonomic nervous system. Our guided breathwork sessions are built on the evidence: Wim Hof, coherence breathing, box breathing, and CO2 tolerance work — applied to your current state.
breathing-sessions.benefitsSubtitle: Breath is the only autonomic function you can consciously control. That makes it uniquely powerful.

0.title: Reduces cortisol
0.description: Slow, rhythmic breathing activates the vagus nerve and shifts the nervous system from sympathetic dominance into parasympathetic recovery — measurably lowering cortisol within minutes.

1.title: Improves heart rate variability
1.description: Coherence breathing at five breaths per minute synchronises heart rate, blood pressure, and baroreflex sensitivity, improving HRV — a key marker of recovery capacity.

2.title: Enhances CO2 tolerance
2.description: Most people over-breathe. Training your tolerance to CO2 improves oxygen delivery to tissues (the Bohr effect) and reduces anxiety responses triggered by hypocapnia.

3.title: Sharpens focus and resilience
3.description: Cyclic hyperventilation followed by breath retention activates the sympathetic system in a controlled way, building mental resilience and cognitive clarity under stress.

breathing-sessions.sessionSubtitle: Every session is guided by a trained instructor. No prior experience required.

I.title: Duration
I.description: 45 minutes. Opening check-in, a 30-minute guided protocol, and a 10-minute integration rest. You may feel light-headed during the session — that is normal and expected.

II.title: Format
II.description: Group sessions run twice a week. Private 1:1 sessions are available for members who prefer a personalised protocol or have specific performance or therapeutic goals.

III.title: Frequency
III.description: One to two sessions per week produces consistent results. Many members combine breathwork with contrast therapy on the same day for a more complete recovery protocol.

breathing-sessions.ctaBody: Breathing Sessions are included in all Essentia memberships. Book your first session or join the community to get started.

red-light-therapy.title: Red Light Therapy
red-light-therapy.heroAlt: Red light therapy panel at Essentia
red-light-therapy.intro: Photobiomodulation uses specific wavelengths of red and near-infrared light to penetrate skin and tissue, stimulating the mitochondria at a cellular level. At Essentia we use medical-grade full-body panels calibrated to the wavelengths with the strongest clinical evidence.
red-light-therapy.benefitsSubtitle: Light therapy works at the cellular level. The effects accumulate with consistent use.

0.title: Stimulates mitochondrial function
0.description: Near-infrared light (810–850 nm) is absorbed by cytochrome c oxidase in the mitochondrial membrane, increasing ATP production and cellular energy availability.

1.title: Accelerates tissue repair
1.description: Red light (630–670 nm) promotes fibroblast proliferation and collagen synthesis, speeding recovery from muscle damage, tendon injuries, and skin conditions.

2.title: Reduces systemic inflammation
2.description: Photobiomodulation consistently reduces markers of oxidative stress and pro-inflammatory cytokines in controlled studies across a wide range of conditions.

3.title: Supports thyroid and hormonal health
3.description: Emerging research shows near-infrared light applied to the thyroid gland can improve function in subclinical hypothyroidism and reduce dependence on medication.

red-light-therapy.sessionSubtitle: Simple, passive, and highly effective. No preparation required.

I.title: Duration
I.description: 10–20 minutes per session. You stand or sit in front of the full-body panel at the prescribed distance. Eyes should be protected with the provided goggles.

II.title: Format
II.description: Solo sessions in a private booth. Skin should be clean and free of sunscreen or thick moisturisers to allow maximum light penetration. Clothing is removed for target areas.

III.title: Frequency
III.description: Three to five sessions per week delivers the best cumulative effect. Many members integrate a 15-minute red light session before or after contrast therapy.

red-light-therapy.ctaBody: Red Light Therapy is included in all Essentia memberships. Book your first session or join the community to get started.

manual-therapies.title: Advanced manual therapy for whole-body care
manual-therapies.intro: At Essentia we treat manual therapy as a deep way of listening to the body. We work on fascia, muscle, joints, the lymphatic system and the nervous system, so each treatment fits what that person actually needs.
manual-therapies.intro2: Every session combines assessment, technique and sensitivity to work the body with precision, building a greater sense of balance, mobility and wellbeing.
manual-therapies.benefitsSubtitle: Every therapy has its own purpose, but they share one intention: to listen to the body, ease what weighs on it and give it back its balance.

0.title: Releases tension and overload
0.description: We work on stiffness, knots and muscular fatigue to help the body let go of built-up tension and find relief.

1.title: Supports the body's recovery
1.description: With manual techniques adapted to you, we support the body through tiredness, physical effort, post-training, pregnancy or too much sun.

2.title: Calms the nervous system
2.description: Enveloping movements, breathing, oils and a conscious rhythm to create deep rest, presence and a real disconnection.

3.title: Brings back lightness and balance
3.description: Each treatment works to restore a sense of fluidity, mobility and wellbeing, adapting to what the body needs that day.

manual-therapies.sessionHeading: What an Essentia session is like
manual-therapies.sessionSubtitle: Every session is built around you. We listen to the body, adapt the treatment and stay with the process before, during and after.

I.title: Listen
I.description: Every body arrives with its own story. We look at tension, inflammation, sensitivity, rest and what you specifically need before we start.

II.title: Treat
II.description: We apply manual techniques suited to where the body actually is that day, minding the pressure, the rhythm, the breathing and every detail of the experience.

III.title: Follow through
III.description: The treatment does not end on the table. We leave you simple guidance to hold on to the lightness, the rest and the balance after the session.

manual-therapies.ctaHeading: Release what is holding you back
manual-therapies.ctaBody: Manual Therapies are available to all Essentia members. Book your first session or join the community to get started.

facial-therapies.title: Therapeutic Facials
facial-therapies.intro: Every face has a story. Our facials combine manual technique, professional cosmetics and a personalised eye, to bring back radiance, firmness and natural harmony.
facial-therapies.benefitsSubtitle: Every facial ritual is built to look after the skin and the face from a deeper standpoint: we are not adding beauty, we are revealing what is already there.

0.title: Restores radiance
0.description: We work the skin with professional cosmetics, exfoliation and manual technique to bring back freshness, nourishment and a more rested look.

1.title: Improves firmness
1.description: Through specific manoeuvres and selected actives, we support the facial structure and help redefine the contour.

2.title: Releases facial tension
2.description: The face carries its load too. We work the muscle, the fascia and the expression to soften tension and bring back harmony.

3.title: Supports how you age
3.description: Our protocols look after the skin and the facial structure from a natural, gradual and non-invasive standpoint.

facial-therapies.sessionSubtitle: Every session begins by looking at the face. Nothing is applied before we understand what the skin needs.

I.title: Assessment
I.description: We look at the state of the skin, the expression, the facial tension and the goal of the treatment, and choose the protocol from there.

II.title: Treatment
II.description: We combine manual technique, professional cosmetics and specific manoeuvres to work on radiance, firmness, structure and facial rest.

III.title: Follow-up
III.description: When the treatment calls for it, as with Kinéa Signature, we set out a personalised plan based on how the face evolves and what each person needs.

facial-therapies.ctaBody: Therapeutic facials are available to all Essentia members. Book your first session or join the community to get started.

treatments.aromaNote: All our therapies use premium oils and essences, with carefully chosen aromatherapy to lift the sensory experience and support the manual work. Where there are allergies, sensitivities or a personal preference, the aromatherapy can be adapted or left out.
treatments.facialsSubtitle: Three rituals designed to look after the skin, support the facial structure and reveal a more natural, radiant and balanced beauty.

aurum.title: Aurum
aurum.description: Radiance, firmness and regeneration with gold leaf, premium Aurum cosmetics and Kobido-inspired technique.

eleva.title: Eleva
eleva.description: Definition, structure and a lifting effect with facial wood therapy, natural hyaluronic acid and specific manual technique.

kinea-signature.title: Kinéa Signature
kinea-signature.description: Full facial re-education, working posture, breathing, fascia, muscle and skin to recover harmony from the structure out.

intravenous-therapy.title: IV Therapy
intravenous-therapy.intro: A new way of supporting wellbeing from within. Personalised intravenous protocols with vitamins, minerals and other micronutrients, brought to Essentia together with VitalDrip and always under medical assessment and supervision.
intravenous-therapy.benefitsSubtitle: Each protocol is chosen for the person and the purpose of the session — never from a generic formula.

0.title: Energy and recovery
0.description: Protocols designed for demanding periods, intense activity or a sense of fatigue, with micronutrients selected case by case.

1.title: Hydration and wellbeing
1.description: The intravenous route allows fluids and micronutrients to be combined within protocols aimed at recovery, hydration and general wellbeing.

2.title: Rest and regulation
2.description: Certain formulas include magnesium, B-group vitamins and other micronutrients to accompany periods of stress, tension and poor sleep. VitalDrip builds this into protocols such as Stress Balance and Calm.

3.title: Antioxidant and cellular support
3.description: Protocols with vitamin C, zinc or glutathione can form part of a personalised antioxidant and recovery strategy, always following professional assessment.

intravenous-therapy.sessionSubtitle: Every experience begins with an assessment. The protocol is decided before any therapy is given.

I.title: Duration
I.description: 45–60 minutes. It can vary with the protocol chosen, its composition and each person's response. VitalDrip's main treatments are designed within this range.

II.title: Personalisation
II.description: One protocol per person. Before the session we go through needs, goals and history to choose the most appropriate formula among those available.

III.title: Supervision
III.description: Always on medical judgement. IV therapy is prescribed and administered by the responsible medical team, who adapt each session individually.

intravenous-therapy.ctaBody: Tell us what you are looking for and we will suggest the protocol that fits.
